blind.description: A clustered pile of antique silverware or pewter tableware consisting of several plates leaning on their edges, a pitcher/jug with an ornate handle, a round lidded tureen or sugar bowl, and several small goblets or chalices standing upright and overturned on the floor. All pieces feature a solid, polished yet tarnished metallic silver/pewter material with natural reflections and ambient occlusion. The objects rest naturally together in a heap directly on the floor with no added plinth.
